---
title: "Lab 01 — Causal questions and description"
output: learnr::tutorial
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("../R/lab_submission.R")
world <- read_csv("data/country_indicators.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
lab_meta <- list(id = "lab01", title = "Causal questions and description")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "Which question is a causal question?",
  q2 = "Life expectancy: is the mean far from the median?",
  q3 = "A group comparison of life expectancy by recent conflict is…",
  q4 = "Rewrite this claim as an effect question: \"Conflict hurts development.\""
)
```

## What you will do

Separate a description from an effect question, then summarise one variable. Download the `.txt` and upload it.

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("What is the effect of a peacekeeping mission on civilian deaths?", correct = TRUE),
  answer("What is the mean life expectancy in this file?"),
  answer("Which region has the highest median GDP?"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r center, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
world |>
  summarise(
    mean_le = mean(life_expectancy),
    median_le = median(life_expectancy)
  )
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("No. They are almost the same (about 71 years).", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Yes. The mean is many years above the median."),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("A description of two groups, not yet a causal effect.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("An average treatment effect, because the variable is coded 0/1."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q4}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q4"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Effect of ___ on ___ for which units?",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = shiny::reactiveValuesToList(learnr::get_tutorial_state()),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
